text: The New Zealand Companies Register lists Winona R&G, LLC, of Chicago, with 126,651,805 of Rodd & Gunn New Zealand Limited's 221,017,780 shares (57.30%). BusinessDesk reported in April 2018 that Winona Capital, a Chicago-based private equity firm, had lifted its holding to about 55 percent of the company.
short: Winona R&G, LLC holds 57.3% of Rodd & Gunn New Zealand.

source.name: New Zealand Companies Office: RODD & GUNN NEW ZEALAND LIMITED (1820324), Shareholdings

additionalSources.quote: Winona bought an additional 16.4 million shares in Rodd & Gunn last July, lifting its holding to about 102.2 million shares, or 55 percent of the company.
